question_text: A 40-year-old pregnant woman presents to the clinic at her 12th week of gestation. She does not have any complaints during this visit but comes to discuss her lab reports from her last visit. Her blood test results are within normal limits, but the abdominal ultrasound reports nuchal thickening with a septated cystic hygroma. Chorionic villus sampling is performed for a suspected chromosomal anomaly. Which of the following features can be expected to be present at the time of birth of this fetus?

She does not have any complaints during this visit but comes to discuss her lab reports from her last visit.
